verdict.rationale:
Medusa's core is open-source and self-hostable, and vendor messaging emphasizes 'you own the project' and full source-code control, plus documented REST/OpenAPI specs (medusa-gh-x1) that could be used to pull data out programmatically. However there is no explicit documented 'export all data' feature, bulk data-export tool, or standardized open-format export (CSV/JSON dump) for leaving the platform — ownership is implied via self-hosting rather than a first-class export capability.

missing for 10: explicit bulk data-export tooling, documented open-format export (CSV/JSON), migration/exit guide confirming full data portability.
